_comment: Ground-truth fixtures for scripts/benchmark_accuracy.py. Ground truth is committed here (small text); the referenced audio under models/ is gitignored and downloaded with the Qwen3 preview model. The harness skips any fixture whose audio is missing and notes it in the report. To add your own committed fixtures, drop a wav under data/benchmark/ and add an entry with a relative path.
